title: Once It Was Done: Participle Clauses and Essay Style
goal: Open a clause with a participle, and shape a short formal essay.
grammar: Once It Was Done: Participle Clauses and Essay Style

items: I can open a clause with a participle that agrees with its noun, as in *Terminada la reunión, salimos*.
I can use *una vez* with a participle to say "once it was done".
I can shape a short formal essay paragraph: a point, a concession, a conclusion.
